decision.why: The last check on 1.0.0 with uncommitted changes left 1 difference unaccounted for.
decision.refusal: Refusing to make 1.0.0 with uncommitted changes the standard for tiny-greeter: the last check left 1 difference nobody accounted for, 1 of which is in a class nobody may wave through. Cutting a broken build as the standard is how a safety net silently becomes a rubber stamp: from tomorrow the tool would call this behaviour correct, stop reporting it, and go on quietly passing every run that keeps it broken. Fix them, or force the cut and accept that it is recorded as forced with the reason above kept beside it.
